scenes.tts: Two routes feed one gracile neuron. How can you tell what each one carries?
scenes.visual: Title card: Silence One Route. The blue direct line and the gold indirect line converge on one gracile neuron. Question on screen: what does each route carry?
scenes.narration: Two routes feed one gracile neuron. How can you tell what each one carries?

scenes.tts: Take one route away at a time, and watch what the neuron loses.
scenes.visual: Two switch icons appear, one on the blue line and one on the gold line. Label: remove one route, compare.
scenes.narration: Take one route away at a time, and watch what the neuron loses.

scenes.tts: Turecek, Lehnert and Ginty recorded single gracile neurons in the hindlimb region of anaesthetized adult mice.
scenes.visual: An electrode lowers into the gracile nucleus of a schematic mouse brainstem. Label: Turecek, Lehnert and Ginty, Nature 2022; adult mice, urethane anaesthesia.
scenes.narration: Turecek, Lehnert and Ginty recorded single gracile neurons in the hindlimb region of anaesthetized adult mice.

scenes.tts: They identified neurons that project to the thalamus. Stimulating their axons there sent spikes backward, checked with a collision test.
scenes.visual: A single flash at the thalamus; a spike runs back down the axon to the recorded neuron. Then a spontaneous spike heading up meets the backward spike, and the expected backward spike never arrives: collision test. Label: projects to the thalamus (VPL).
scenes.narration: They identified neurons that project to the thalamus. Stimulating their axons there sent spikes backward, checked with a collision test.

scenes.tts: Switch one removes the direct route. Light on the gracile nucleus silences the afferent terminals there, through a light-gated chloride channel.
scenes.visual: A ramp of yellow-green light falls on the blue-coded afferent terminals in the gracile nucleus; the blue input dims, while the afferent's branches in the lumbar cord stay active. Label: ACR1 silencing at the gracile nucleus.
scenes.narration: Switch one removes the direct route. Light on the gracile nucleus silences the afferent terminals there, through a light-gated chloride channel.

scenes.tts: Switch two removes the indirect route. Drugs on the lumbar cord block its spinal synapses. The afferents’ direct branches climb past without a spinal synapse, so they keep conducting.
scenes.visual: A drop of drug falls on the lumbar cord; the synapses onto the gold PSDC neuron go grey and the gold line dims. Label: glutamate receptor antagonists, lumbar cord. The blue axon running up the dorsal column stays bright past the drugged segment. Label: direct axons still conduct.
scenes.narration: Switch two removes the indirect route. Drugs on the lumbar cord block its spinal synapses. The afferents’ direct branches climb past without a spinal synapse, so they keep conducting.

scenes.tts: Then three stimuli on the hindpaw. A vibration. A gentle displacement of the skin. And a sustained press with a blunt probe.
scenes.visual: Three icons on the paw: a vibrating pin, a gentle nudge, a blunt probe pressing and holding. On screen: blunt 1-mm probe, 1 to 300 mN.
scenes.narration: Then three stimuli on the hindpaw. A vibration. A gentle displacement of the skin. And a sustained press with a blunt probe.

scenes.tts: Pause and predict. Which route carries vibration? Which carries a hard, sustained press? And gentle displacement?
scenes.visual: An empty three-by-two table: rows vibration, gentle displacement, sustained press; columns direct route, indirect route. Each cell shows a question mark.
scenes.narration: Pause and predict. Which route carries vibration? Which carries a hard, sustained press? And gentle displacement?

scenes.tts: Vibration first. The direct input carried vibration with high temporal precision, up to high frequencies. The indirect route can add to slow, ten hertz vibration.
scenes.caption: Vibration first. The direct input carried vibration with high temporal precision, up to high frequencies. The indirect route can add to slow, 10 hertz vibration.
scenes.visual: Vibration row fills: direct, carried with high temporal precision, including high frequencies; indirect, can contribute at low frequency (10 Hz). A spike train locks crisply to a fast sine wave beside the blue column.
scenes.narration: Vibration first. The direct input carried vibration with high temporal precision, up to high frequencies. The indirect route can add to slow, 10 hertz vibration.

scenes.tts: Now the press. Blocking the spinal synapses almost eliminated sustained firing in most neurons.
scenes.visual: Sustained-press row fills: indirect, carried. Beside it, two representative units side by side, labelled different units: a control unit firing a long steady bar during a held press, and a unit recorded with the lumbar synapses blocked, almost silent.
scenes.narration: Now the press. Blocking the spinal synapses almost eliminated sustained firing in most neurons.

scenes.tts: The block also raised the force needed to make the neuron fire at all. So the indirect route is not just a late add-on.
scenes.visual: A force axis with an arrow marking the onset threshold sliding to the right after the drug. Label: onset threshold raised.
scenes.narration: The block also raised the force needed to make the neuron fire at all. So the indirect route is not just a late add-on.

scenes.tts: Gentle displacement used both routes. So direct for vibration, indirect for light touch, is too simple.
scenes.visual: Gentle-displacement row fills: contributes, contributes. A crossed-out slogan: direct = vibration, indirect = light touch.
scenes.narration: Gentle displacement used both routes. So direct for vibration, indirect for light touch, is too simple.

scenes.tts: Now map each input's receptive field on one neuron. The direct and indirect fields were highly aligned.
scenes.visual: Two identical, registered paw outlines: the blue field on one, the gold field on the other. One fades over the other without moving, turning or rescaling; the fields overlap on one patch. Label: highly aligned receptive fields.
scenes.narration: Now map each input's receptive field on one neuron. The direct and indirect fields were highly aligned.

scenes.tts: So the two routes are not two maps. They are two reports on one spot, meeting on one neuron.
scenes.visual: Both lines converge on one gracile neuron above the single patch. On screen: two reports, one spot, one neuron.
scenes.narration: So the two routes are not two maps. They are two reports on one spot, meeting on one neuron.

scenes.tts: One limit. The light silencer was validated only for gentle forces. So the high-force result rests on the drug.
scenes.visual: Caveat card: ACR1 validated only up to about 20 to 30 mN; high-force conclusion rests on the lumbar drug.
scenes.narration: One limit. The light silencer was validated only for gentle forces. So the high-force result rests on the drug.

scenes.tts: And that drug is not specific to P S D C neurons.
scenes.caption: And that drug is not specific to PSDC neurons.
scenes.visual: The drug drop on the cord greys out several neuron types, not just the PSDC neuron. Label: not PSDC-specific.
scenes.narration: And that drug is not specific to PSDC neurons.

scenes.tts: And strong firing at high force is not by itself evidence of pain. In awake mice, the high-force press evoked no pain-related behaviour.
scenes.visual: An awake mouse, head-fixed on an acrylic platform, with the blunt probe pressing its hindlimb; the paw is not withdrawn. Label: awake control trials; no withdrawal or pain-related behaviour with this probe.
scenes.narration: And strong firing at high force is not by itself evidence of pain. In awake mice, the high-force press evoked no pain-related behaviour.

scenes.tts: The takeaway: fast timing rides the direct route. Sustained pressure rides the indirect one. Gentle touch uses both, and both report the same skin.
scenes.visual: The completed table, with the two columns tinted blue and gold. Takeaway on screen: fast timing rides the direct route; sustained pressure rides the indirect one; gentle touch uses both; same skin.
scenes.narration: The takeaway: fast timing rides the direct route. Sustained pressure rides the indirect one. Gentle touch uses both, and both report the same skin.
